description: This file manages the settings interface and operations for calendar synchronization within the SuiteCRM administration module, including handling user permissions, performing sync actions, saving configurations, and rendering the settings template.

classes.name: CalendarSync
classes.description: Class responsible for managing calendar synchronization operations and configurations.

classes.name: Sugar_Smarty
classes.description: Template rendering class used for displaying the UI.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of CalendarSync.

methods.name: syncAllCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Triggers synchronization for all calendar accounts.

methods.name: getConflictResolutionCases
methods.description: Retrieves the list of conflict resolution options for calendar sync.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Returns the scheduler object managing scheduled sync tasks.
